name: stockreef-submission-videos
description: The StockReef pitch and demo videos, as one Remotion project. Not part of the app build.

scripts.prepare:pitch: node scripts/timeline.mjs pitch && node scripts/music.mjs pitch
scripts.render:pitch: npm run prepare:pitch && remotion render src/index.ts Pitch out/stockreef-pitch-music-only.mp4
scripts.render:pitch-guide: npm run prepare:pitch && remotion render src/index.ts PitchGuide out/stockreef-pitch-guide.mp4
scripts.render:demo: npm run prepare:demo && remotion render src/index.ts Demo out/stockreef-demo-music-only.mp4
scripts.render:demo-guide: npm run prepare:demo && remotion render src/index.ts DemoGuide out/stockreef-demo-guide.mp4
